title: Center Console Layout, Storage, and Controls
summary: Feedback on the center console centers on complaints about cramped layout and storage, scratch-prone glossy trim, and some control usability issues, while many sampled fragments are descriptive or preference-based rather than clearly sentiment-labeled.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on a terrible or too-small center console layout and storage area, along with glossy trim that scratches easily and is hard to keep looking clean.

mixed.summary: The mixed review in this topic appears to concern braking smoothness rather than the center console itself, so the sampled evidence is insufficient to summarize a console-specific mixed sentiment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments include factual notes and preferences about console port locations, button behavior, storage limitations, controller position, glare, and desired haptic feedback without a clear overall sentiment label.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confident interpretation of overall sentiment for several console-related issues.
The topic cluster appears somewhat noisy because at least one mixed example concerns braking behavior rather than the center console.
Examples are limited and stratified rather than representative, so they should not be used to infer broader prevalence beyond this sample.
